name: @lit-core/props-lower
description: High-performance native Rust AOT AST transformer for Lit decorators and properties via OXC

scripts.build: cargo build --release && cp target/release/libprops_lower.dylib props-lower.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:debug: cargo build && cp target/debug/libprops_lower.dylib props-lower.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true
